title: Mon Coran, mon trésor

inspiration.title: Anachid | Mon Coran | chanson islamique pour les petits musulmans (Paradise's voice)
inspiration.why: 9 M de vues, aucune autre version animée française trouvée sur YouTube. On garde le thème (l'amour du Coran) mais histoire, personnages et paroles sont nouveaux.
inspiration.reference_lyrics: Mon Coran, mon Coran, tu es la lumière de mon cœur. Mon Coran, mon Coran, tu dissipes toutes mes peurs. Mon Coran, mon Coran, tu es le printemps de ma vie. Mon Coran, mon Coran, je te récite et plus de soucis. Des versets du Créateur pour ses humbles serviteurs. Bénédiction et serment mon Coran. Ici-bas et dans les cieux luit la parole de Dieu. Miséricorde et guérison mon Coran. Le meilleur de tous les livres que tout musulman doit suivre. Pour être droit, juste et bon mon Coran. J'apprends ses versets par cœur, c'est ma source de bonheur. Préservé par le Très-Haut, mon Coran.

style: Pixar-style 3D animation, soft pastel colors, warm golden light, cozy Muslim family home, children's cartoon, wide 16:9 framing, no text overlay.
music: Gentle and warm Islamic nursery-rhyme song for kids, sung in French, tender catchy melody, soft daf drum, light bells and hand claps.
reference_image: Wide shot of a cozy Muslim family living room with mint green walls, oriental arches, green plants, a crescent moon lamp and floor cushions. A kind grandfather sits on a cushion holding a closed book with a golden cover wrapped in green cloth, his little granddaughter stands next to him, her mother stands smiling behind them, a small fennec fox sits on the rug.

Amina.look: 4-year-old girl, caramel skin, big brown eyes, very curly black hair with a knotted yellow headband, pale yellow pajamas with little lilac moons and stars.

Papi.look: kind grandfather, short neat white beard, round glasses, white kufi cap, long beige thobe, warm smile.

Maman.look: gentle young mother ALWAYS wearing a light beige hijab fully covering her hair and neck, long lilac dress with puffy sleeves.

Fennec.look: small cream fennec fox with big ears and a turquoise scarf.

scenes.image: Cozy living room. Papi sits on a floor cushion holding a closed book with a golden cover wrapped in green cloth, Amina stands next to him, curious, pointing at the book.
scenes.action: Amina points at the golden book with wide curious eyes, Papi smiles tenderly and lifts the book gently. Slow camera push-in.

lyrics.singer: Amina, with a sweet little-girl voice,
lyrics.text: Papi, c'est quoi ce beau livre tout doré ?

lyrics.singer: Papi, with a warm gentle grandfather voice,
lyrics.text: C'est le Coran, ma chérie, la parole d'Allah !

scenes.image: Pastel bathroom. Amina stands on a small wooden stool at the sink, water running, washing her hands, the fennec watches from the side.
scenes.action: Amina washes her hands, then her face with sparkling water, smiling, the fennec tilts its head.

lyrics.singer: Amina, with a sweet little-girl voice,
lyrics.text: Avant de le toucher, je fais mes ablutions,
les mains, le visage, avec attention !

scenes.image: Amina and Papi sit side by side on floor cushions, an open book rests on a small carved wooden stand in front of them, soft golden light from the window.
scenes.action: Amina claps softly and sways joyfully next to Papi, who smiles and nods to the rhythm.

lyrics.text: Mon Coran, mon trésor, je le lis encore et encore !
Mon Coran, mon ami, avec toi je grandis !

scenes.image: Close shot: Papi points with his finger at a page of the open book on the wooden stand, Amina leans forward and follows with her little finger, focused and happy.
scenes.action: Papi guides Amina's finger along the page, Amina nods proudly.

lyrics.singer: Amina, with a sweet little-girl voice,
lyrics.text: Alif, Ba, Ta, lettre après lettre,

scenes.image: Amina sits alone on a cozy window seat with cushions, reading an open book on her lap, a sunbeam lights her face, plants around.
scenes.action: Amina reads quietly, then looks up with a peaceful smile, the sunbeam glows.

lyrics.singer: Amina, softly, with a sweet little-girl voice,
lyrics.text: Je lis tout doucement, sans me presser,
et mon cœur se remplit de paix !

scenes.image: Bright flowery garden with butterflies. Amina holds a closed book with a golden cover respectfully against her chest, smiling, one fennec hops beside her.
scenes.action: Amina walks happily among the flowers holding the book against her chest, the fennec hops around her, butterflies flutter.

lyrics.singer: Amina, cheerfully, with a sweet little-girl voice,
lyrics.text: Mon Coran, mon trésor, je le lis encore et encore !
Mon Coran, mon ami, avec toi je grandis !

scenes.image: Amina's pastel bedroom. Amina sits on the rug facing her fennec, telling it a story with expressive hands, the fennec listens with big ears up.
scenes.action: Amina tells the fennec what she learned, making gentle gestures, the fennec wags its tail.

lyrics.singer: Amina, with a sweet little-girl voice,
lyrics.text: À mon petit fennec, je raconte à mon tour,
ce que Papi m'a appris avec amour !

scenes.image: Evening in the living room. Amina stands on her tiptoes placing a book wrapped in green cloth on a high wooden shelf, Maman in her beige hijab helps her and smiles proudly.
scenes.action: Amina places the wrapped book on the high shelf with care, Maman gently holds her and smiles.

lyrics.singer: Amina, with a sweet little-girl voice,
lyrics.text: Je le range tout en haut, avec respect,
mon Coran bien au chaud, enveloppé !

scenes.image: Night, Amina's bedroom with a starry sky and a golden crescent moon through the window. Amina sits in bed, Maman in her beige hijab and Papi sit on each side of the bed, all smiling.
scenes.action: Soft lullaby mood, all three sway gently, Amina yawns and smiles, stars twinkle. Slow camera pull back to the window.

lyrics.singer: Amina, Maman and Papi together, softly like a lullaby,
lyrics.text: Mon Coran, mon trésor, je le lis encore et encore !
Mon Coran, mon ami, avec toi je grandis !

youtube.title: Mon Coran, mon trésor 📖 Comptine islamique pour enfants | Amina et Papi
youtube.hook:
📖 Amina découvre un beau livre doré chez Papi : le Coran, la parole d'Allah !
Avec Papi, elle apprend à faire ses ablutions, à reconnaître les lettres Alif, Ba, Ta, à lire tout doucement et à ranger son Coran avec respect.

✨ Ce que votre enfant va apprendre :
• Aimer le Coran et le lire chaque jour
• Faire ses ablutions avant de le toucher
• Le respect du Coran (on le range en hauteur, enveloppé)
• Les premières lettres : Alif, Ba, Ta
